title: Ease of driving and operation
summary: Feedback centers on the G60 being easy to drive and operate, with one complaint about a less convenient physical key release and many short fragments that mention simplicity without enough context for clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the G60 for being simple to drive, straightforward to operate, and easy to use for features like preconditioning and infotainment.

negative.summary: Negative feedback complains that removing the physical key is harder than before because a simple release button is no longer available.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention simplicity in driving, charging, cabin layout, buttons, and climate controls, but several are too brief or ambiguous to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Most fragments are very short, which limits confidence in interpreting the intent behind mentions of simplicity.
The topic mixes several subtopics, including driving ease, charging, cabin layout, buttons, climate controls, and key access, rather than one single feature area.
Many examples are labeled undetermined, so the available evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
